entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A hunter of Yasova's clan and twin of Baishya who fights fiercely and protects her sister.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A young whisperer (shaman) who hears the windfolk and receives a vision of the birth of the dragons.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The twins' grandmother and a former clan chief who leads the hunting band and hides the dragon claw staff from Atarka.

entities.name: Windfolk
entities.description: Gauzy, tentacle-haired air elementals who come to Baishya to warn her and pass on a message.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A Dragonlord who demands tribute of meat, bans the name Dragonclaw, and eats those who use it.

entities.name: Atarka's broodlings
entities.description: Dragons of Atarka's brood who land at the camp demanding the surrender of shamans.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A newly born dragon, twin of Ugin, who is stuck under debris, angry at hunters, and who later flies after other dragons.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Nicol's twin, a clever young dragon whose vision passes to Baishya and who calls to Yasova from beyond death.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: A bright dragon who names itself and flies off to the settlement.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: A metallic dragon, curious, who lands on the mountain peak and flies off to seek cousins.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: A reddish-green dragon with spiral horns who calls the two weak eggs useless and goes hunting.

entities.name: Merrevia Sal
entities.description: A green dragon who crashes into a clearing, injured, is killed by hunters despite killing five of them.

entities.name: The great shadow
entities.description: A vast, blind, shadowy creature whose wing beats storm eggs out of the sky; progenitor of the dragons in the vision.

entities.name: Hunters
entities.description: Humans with nets, spears and dogs who bring down Merrevia Sal in the vision.

entities.name: Eternal Ice
entities.description: A sacred mountain whose snowfield breaks in an avalanche.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: The mountain range where the hunting party camps.

entities.name: Ayagor
entities.description: A permanent encampment devoted to feeding Atarka.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the twins live; the world in the vision is explicitly not Tarkir.

entities.name: The dragon claw staff
entities.description: The staff that once marked Yasova as clan chief, hidden in a secret cave while a fake was given to Atarka.

events.summary: Naiva and Baishya climb the sacred mountain and hear ticking noises; Baishya says her vision led them there.
events.quote: You're too impatient. My vision led me right here, I'm sure of it.

events.summary: An avalanche breaks across the Eternal Ice snowfield and buries the twins.
events.quote: The snow broke, starting to slide.

events.summary: Baishya's hands glow green and she shapes the snow into a wall that holds against the avalanche.
events.quote: her sister began to mold and shape the crushing snow into a wall in front of them.

events.summary: Gauzy windfolk emerge from the snow and Baishya faints trying to hear them; Naiva grabs her spear, thinking they are a threat.
events.quote: The windfolk came to warn us, not to hurt us.

events.summary: Baishya says the windfolk called her up to give a message for Grandmother.
events.quote: They called me up here to give me a message for Grandmother.

events.summary: Naiva kills a goblin that ambushes her among a pack of avalanche-crushed goblins.
events.quote: then circled her spear point back and skewered it with a thrust through the eye into the brain.

events.summary: Dragons melt the snow with fire and flood the valley, and Naiva worries what she will do if Grandmother is dead.
events.quote: People who wouldn't just turn her twin over to Atarka once they discovered she was a shaman.

events.summary: The twins find the hunting party alive on a hill above the flood, and Yasova asks Baishya to report what happened.
events.quote: Grandmother was tending to several injured people.

events.summary: Baishya addresses her grandmother as Yasova Dragonclaw, a name Atarka has banned, and slips into a whisper trance.
events.quote: Atarka had banished the name Dragonclaw and eaten every person who had dared use the term in her presence.

events.summary: In the vision, a blind great shadow beats its wings and drops egg-stones from which dragons wake, as Arcades Sabboth, Chromium Rhuell and Palladia-Mors name themselves.
events.quote: By naming itself it takes control of its own destiny.

events.summary: Two large egg-stones crack into the ground without waking, and Palladia-Mors dismisses them as weak and goes hunting.
events.quote: These two were too weak to wake up. Good riddance.

events.summary: Merrevia Sal crashes into a clearing and demands meat from a party of hunters.
events.quote: I am Merrevia Sal. Give me the meat, or I will kill you.

events.summary: The last egg-stone unfurls into twin dragons, Nicol and Ugin, who crash through the canopy; Nicol is pinned by a tree trunk.
events.quote: You're Nicol, aren't you? That's your name.

events.summary: Hunters work together to net and kill Merrevia Sal while Nicol, pinned, wants to help but Ugin holds him back.
events.quote: Yet still she struggles, still she fights because she is a dragon, and dragons never bow before lesser creatures.

events.summary: Ugin clamps Nicol's muzzle to hush him as Merrevia is hunted into the trees and dies.
events.quote: Ugin clamps talons over his muzzle, smothering him.

events.summary: Nicol is freed and finds the clearing too late; he wants revenge but Ugin urges finding their siblings first.
events.quote: We must find the others first. Safety in numbers, as the hunters had.

events.summary: Nicol rips off a dog's head and flies awkwardly to the peak with Ugin.
events.quote: He leaps forward onto the lead dog and rips its head off with a single bite.

events.summary: From the peak Nicol sees the bodies of weak dragons and decides being the hunter is better, while Ugin stares at the sky and asks where they came from.
events.quote: Dying isn't wonderful. It's bad. But being the hunter: that's a better thing.

events.summary: In the vision Ugin calls Yasova Dragonclaw to come to him.
events.quote: Someone is looking for you, Yasova Dragonclaw. Come to me.

events.summary: Three of Atarka's broodlings land at the camp demanding the clan surrender its shamans.
events.quote: We smell magic in the air. Surrender your shamans to us, or we will kill you all.

events.summary: Yasova lies that the camp stood on the hill and distracts the broodlings with the goblin corpses.
events.quote: For your trouble, and out of respect, we have gathered a little snack for you.

events.summary: Baishya explains the vision came from Ugin and they must go to his grave.
events.quote: That's why we have to go to Ugin's grave.

relations.quote: So they would die together as they had been born together, locked in a cold tomb.

relations.note: grandmother of the twins, who call her Grandmother
relations.quote: Grandmother was tending to several injured people.
It unfurls into not one, but two small dragons born twinned together.
Atarka had banished the name Dragonclaw and eaten every person who had dared use the term in her presence.
This work is forbidden to you by order of Dragonlord Atarka.

relations.note: they net and spear her to death
relations.quote: Two hunters thrust into her right eye.

relations.note: Nicol wants to burn them in vengeance
Ugin and Nicol call her their sister
relations.quote: We are smaller than our sister.

relations.note: Ugin's vision was passed to Baishya through the windfolk
relations.quote: The vision was passed to me by the windfolk but it didn't come from them.
